title: Trade Spend Accrual and Payout Reconciliation
summary: Compare what finance accrued for each scheme with what was claimed and paid, find over-accruals, unclaimed schemes and late claims, and close the month with a clear trade spend position.

seo.title: Trade Spend Accrual Reconciliation | VipraTech
seo.description: Reconcile trade scheme accruals with claims and payouts by scheme, distributor and month, and find over-accruals, unclaimed schemes and late claims.

problem.intro: Every month finance accrues a liability for schemes running in the market, based on sales and scheme terms. Claims arrive weeks or months later, at different amounts. The gap between accrued and paid sits on the balance sheet, and at quarter or year end someone has to explain it.

pain_points.title: Accruals estimated in spreadsheets
pain_points.detail: Monthly accruals are worked out from sales and scheme terms by hand, and the logic changes with whoever prepares them.

pain_points.title: Claims that never come
pain_points.detail: Some schemes are never fully claimed, and the unused accrual sits on the books until someone writes it back.

pain_points.title: Late claims for closed periods
pain_points.detail: Distributors claim against schemes from earlier quarters, after the accrual was reversed or the books were closed.

pain_points.title: Trade spend that cannot be explained
pain_points.detail: Management asks what a scheme actually cost, and the answer needs days of reconciliation.

solution.overview: VipraTech calculates the expected liability for each scheme from sales and the scheme's rules, and compares it with what finance accrued and with what was claimed and paid, by scheme, distributor and month. It shows over- and under-accruals, schemes with no claims after their claim window, and claims that arrive after a period was closed. Finance gets a reconciliation for month-end close and a report of what each scheme actually cost.
capabilities: Expected liability per scheme from sales and scheme rules
Comparison of expected, accrued, claimed and paid amounts by scheme and month
Unclaimed schemes past their claim window
Month-end reconciliation with suggested adjustments for finance
Actual cost of each scheme for management reporting

workflow.title: Load schemes and sales
workflow.detail: Scheme rules and sales for the period are taken from the scheme register and the DMS or ERP.

workflow.title: Calculate expected liability
workflow.detail: Each scheme's expected liability is calculated by distributor and month.

workflow.title: Compare
workflow.detail: Expected liability is compared with accruals booked and with claims received and paid.

workflow.title: Explain gaps
workflow.detail: Over- and under-accruals, unclaimed schemes and late claims are listed with reasons.

workflow.title: Finance review
workflow.detail: Finance reviews the gaps and decides on write-backs and adjustments.

workflow.title: Close and report
workflow.detail: A month-end reconciliation and a scheme cost report are produced.

match_rules.logic: Expected liability is recalculated from billed or secondary sales against each scheme's rules, not from the original budget.
The booked accrual for each scheme is compared with expected liability less payments already made.
Once a scheme's claim window closes, accrual left above pending claims is flagged for release.
Each payout or credit note must map to a scheme and period, so spend lands against the right accrual.
Claims received but not yet settled count as liability, at their recalculated value.

exception_codes.meaning: Expected liability is above the accrual.
The accrual is above expected liability.
exception_codes.action: Release the excess, with finance sign-off.

exception_codes.meaning: A closed scheme still carries accrual.
exception_codes.action: Release it, or confirm the claims still to come.

exception_codes.meaning: A payout or credit note has no scheme.
exception_codes.action: Map it to the right scheme.

exception_codes.meaning: Sales data for the period is incomplete.
exception_codes.action: Hold the estimate until the data arrives.

faqs.q: Do we need to use your claims system first?
faqs.a: It helps, because claims then arrive structured. But it can work from your claim and payment sheets.

faqs.q: Will it post entries to our ERP?
faqs.a: No. It suggests entries with their workings for finance to post. Posting can be added later with your approval.

faqs.q: Can it handle schemes that span quarters?
faqs.a: Yes. Liability is calculated by month and scheme, so schemes that span periods are split correctly.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: About 8 weeks from the first files to go-live. The first cycle runs beside your current process on your own data, and your team switches over once the results agree with what it would have settled.
